$comment: SYNTHETIC supplementary cases for rules the RESEARCH-006 manual retrieval reconciliation encoded but which are NOT in the published live set — TL-JOB-003 and TL-MAL-002 (implementability PARTIAL, status APPROVED) and TL-MAL-001 / TL-MAL-003 / TL-INV-003 (PARTIAL, status PEER_REVIEW). They are kept out of seed-corpus-v1.json so they do not violate that corpus's invariant that no malicious case expects a DEFERRED/partial-implementability rule. The rule-runner evaluates them to prove the reconciled rule logic and its suppressors. NONE is a real-world sample.
phase2_expected_outcome_semantics: RENAMED 2026-08-29 from 'expected_outcome' for the Phase-3 closure (GATE-009). Coarse Phase-2 finding/severity EXPECTATION (NO_FINDING / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / MEDIUM / HIGH / CRITICAL), design intent only. NOT the DET-001 runtime severity, which is derived from the governed rule that fires (DET-001 sections 4-5, ADR-0006). No rule meaning changed.
usage_constraints: Determinism and regression testing of the reconciled rule logic ONLY.
MUST NOT be used to claim precision/recall/false-positive rate (RSK-003, G-09).

benign.text: Congratulations on joining Example Analytics! Your onboarding tasks are in the portal. There is no fee, deposit or investment at any stage — your salary is credited monthly. Welcome aboard!
benign.rationale: A genuine task/job onboarding mentions tasks and earning but demands no deposit and blocks no withdrawal. EXPLICIT_NO_FEE suppresses TL-JOB-003; the discriminating blocked-withdrawal step is absent.

benign.text: As you requested with the IT helpdesk, we will start a TeamViewer session at 3pm to fix your laptop display. This is an internal support session for your work device; no bank or payment details are involved.
benign.rationale: Legitimate, user-initiated IT support names a screen-sharing app but in a non-banking work context. TL-MAL-003 is scoped to a banking/authority/payment context AND is suppressed by IT_SUPPORT_CONTEXT — this is the 'legitimate IT support distinguishable from banking screen-share' requirement.

benign.text: Your Example Bank app update is available. Please update it only from the official Google Play Store or Apple App Store. Do not install any APK from links.
benign.rationale: Directs the user to an official store — the inverse of an untrusted-source install prompt. OFFICIAL_APP_STORE_SOURCE suppresses TL-MAL-001.

malicious.text: Easy part-time job! Complete simple tasks and earn daily. Deposit Rs 5,000 to activate premium tasks and unlock higher commissions. Your balance shows Rs 42,000 — but to withdraw you must first pay a 10% tax deposit.
malicious.rationale: Task-app chain verified by the PIB-2023 + I4C-2025 replacement pair (MR-EVID-012/013): earning lure + deposit + blocked-withdrawal-with-further-payment. Contrast with RB-001.

malicious.text: Your KYC app is ready. Install Bank-Verify.apk from this link and, when prompted, turn ON Accessibility permission so the app can auto-complete your verification.
malicious.rationale: Accessibility-permission abuse verified by I4C CyberDost (SRC-019, MR-EVID-009): out-of-context Accessibility grant plus a fake-app/link delivery vector. Contrast with B-013, where the same actions are named inside an official warning and suppressed.

malicious.text: Update required: your payment app is outdated. Install the new version now from this link: http://bit.example/appx — do not use the store, this build is exclusive.
malicious.rationale: Untrusted, non-store install prompt via a shortened link. Narrowed rule (iOS config-profile excluded). Contrast with RB-003, which points to the official store.

malicious.text: This is Example Bank support. To resolve the failed debit on your account, please install AnyDesk and share the 9-digit code so our officer can guide your KYC re-verification.
malicious.rationale: Screen-share app requested inside a banking-support pretext — named on HDFC's current page (SRC-026, MR-EVID-006). Contrast with RB-002, a non-banking user-initiated IT session.

malicious.text: As seen on TV! [Famous Actor] reveals the trading app that guarantees 200% returns. Join his exclusive group now — thousands are already earning risk-free!
malicious.rationale: Celebrity impersonation in a social-media investment funnel, verified by SEBI PR 27/2025 body (MR-EVID-005). NOTE: no deepfake claim is made — that mechanism stays out of scope (G-16).
